subtitle.en: A vocabulary mastery platform for Secondary Chinese Language
subtitle.zh: 中学华文词汇掌握平台

summary.en: 3,741 vocabulary items spanning the G1 through Higher Chinese streams, with progression, streaks and self-selected difficulty. Every mechanic is grounded in Self-Determination Theory and Assessment for Learning rather than bolted on afterwards.
summary.zh: 3,741 个词条，横跨 G1 至高级华文四个语文流，具备进度系统、连续挑战与自选难度。每一项机制都以自我决定理论（SDT）与促进学习的评价（AfL）为设计起点，而非事后附加。

highlight.en: Designed and built solo, in conversation with an AI agent (Claude Code), on a Firebase backend, with no engineering team, no external funding and no prior coding background.
highlight.zh: 独立完成设计与开发，全程与 AI agent（Claude Code）协作，采用 Firebase 架构：没有开发团队，没有外部资金，也没有任何编程背景。

caption.en: The four streams, G1 through Higher Chinese
caption.zh: 四大语文流 · 从 G1 到高级华文

caption.en: 我的词山 · the personal progress map
caption.zh: 我的词山 · 个人进度地图

caption.en: Choosing scope and difficulty, never assigned
caption.zh: 自选范围与难度，而非系统分配

summary.en: A platformer that teaches Secondary 3 G3 students to recognise argumentation techniques in two set texts. Six lives instead of three: a deliberate accommodation so lower-readiness students finish rather than give up.
summary.zh: 以横向卷轴游戏教中三 G3 学生辨识两篇课文中的论证法。生命值设为六条而非三条：这是刻意的调整，让准备度较低的学生能够完成，而不是中途放弃。
